title: b7z9.16.1(c): C DAO TX timing orchestrator composing the three timers + host test
description: Parent: project-LICHEN-worker6-b7z9.16.1. NEW code in lichen/subsys/lichen/rpl/rpl_dao_timing.c (+ header decls): struct lichen_rpl_dao_tx_timing composing initial_timer/retry_timer/refresh_timer with an explicit phase (idle/initial-pending/retry-pending/refresh-pending/exhausted) and transitions mirroring rust dao_tx_timing.rs (commit 870577f9db): on_join draws initial delay via the injectable RNG and arms the initial timer; on_send consumes a due timer and advances to retry backoff 4/8/16s; on_ack resets retries and starts the 900s refresh; on_leave resets to idle. All timing constants come from rpl_dao_timing.h — no duplication. Host test in lichen/tests/rpl_dao_timing/ (extend main.c or new file): assert join delay window, retry sequence 4/8/16 then exhausted, ack resets to 900s refresh, leave resets. Runtime-loop wiring is sibling .2.
close_reason: Duplicate of b7z9.16.1.1 (same description, same parent). Already resolved: the composing struct and phase enum already exist in rpl_dao_timing.{c,h}. See the close reason for .16.1.1.
